title: Find Nonzero Elements
text: Find nonzero elements in array, 1 input, 2 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Mode} sets Select data type mode; {Index output format} sets the format for indices of nonzero elements Linear, {Number of input dimensions} sets the number of dimensions for the input signal, {Index mode} sets the zero- or one-based, {Show output port for nonzero input values} enables output port for nonzero values, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {Output data type}, {Data type override} sets the data type override mode for this signal, {Signedness} sets the signed, {Word length} sets the bit size of the word that holds the quantized and {Scaling} sets the method for scaling your fixed-point data. Values come from the instance.
